title: A Letter for the Confession
author: Lena Crane
blurb: Casper Thackeray, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
